  Line or code reference: lines 71, 78 (and twin .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: lines 71, 78)
  Problem: The one-re-dispatch limit on security-pass and validation run mismatches cannot be enforced across fresh stage sessions because the re-dispatch state is not persisted.
  Why it fails at runtime: A fresh session cannot distinguish a replacement run from an initial run and may re-dispatch again instead of halting at `Status: BLOCKED`.

  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Line or code reference: line 288 (and twin .claude/scripts/dispatch_workflow.py: line 288)
  Problem: The ambiguous-candidates error says "never dispatch again", contradicting the one bounded re-dispatch allowed after all candidates complete without a match.
  Why it fails at runtime: An unattended agent reading the error may stop at `Status: BLOCKED` instead of performing the allowed re-dispatch.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: "A mismatch triggers one re-dispatch, and a second mismatch stops the project at Status: BLOCKED." (PR description, lead bullet; docs/plans/issue-5841-verify-audited-commit-plan.md AD-5 and Goal G5; changelog.d/5841-verify-audited-commit.md).
  Expected change site: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md steps 9 (line 71) and 10 (line 78), the stage session resume block (lines 126-132), and the progress log header contract (lines 310-322) (and .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md twin).
  Evidence of absence: The command prose specifies the second-mismatch stop, but neither the waiting-on line, resume block, nor progress log schema defines a field, flag, or counter to track whether a re-dispatch has already occurred.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
